## 🎯 PR Classification

<!--
Select the primary type of change. This drives automated labeling,
required reviewers, and CI pipeline selection.
Replace [ ] with [x] for all that apply.
-->

### Change Type
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix** — Fixes a reported issue (non-breaking)
- [ ] ✨ **Feature** — Adds new functionality (non-breaking)
- [ ] 🎨 **Theme** — New or updated theme (use theme template instead)
- [ ] 🔌 **Plugin** — New or updated plugin (use plugin template instead)
- [ ] 📖 **Documentation** — Documentation changes only
- [ ] ♻️ **Refactor** — Code restructure without behavior change
- [ ] ⚡ **Performance** — Performance improvement
- [ ] 🔒 **Security** — Security fix or hardening
- [ ] 💔 **Breaking Change** — Changes existing behavior or API
- [ ] 🔧 **Config** — Configuration changes
- [ ] 🧪 **Tests** — Adding or updating tests
- [ ] 🏗️ **CI/CD** — Workflow or pipeline changes
- [ ] 🌍 **i18n** — Internationalization / translation
- [ ] ♿ **Accessibility** — Accessibility improvement
- [ ] 🐧 **Distro Compat** — Distribution compatibility fix
- [ ] 🧹 **Chore** — Dependency updates, cleanup, housekeeping

### Scope
- [ ] 🖥️ **Desktop** — Hyprland, Waybar, Rofi, desktop components
- [ ] ⚡ **ASH CLI** — Command-line interface and engines
- [ ] 📝 **Neovim** — Neovim configuration and plugins
- [ ] 🐟 **Fish Shell** — Fish shell configuration and functions
- [ ] 🌐 **REST API** — API server and endpoints
- [ ] 📱 **Mobile** — Mobile companion app
- [ ] 🖥️ **Web Dashboard** — Web dashboard UI
- [ ] 🔌 **Plugin System** — Plugin infrastructure
- [ ] 🎨 **Theme Engine** — Color extraction, generation, templating
- [ ] ❄️ **Nix** — Nix flake and NixOS modules
- [ ] 🐋 **Docker** — Container configuration
- [ ] 📦 **Packaging** — AUR, Flatpak, AppImage
- [ ] 🧪 **Tests** — Test infrastructure
- [ ] 📖 **Docs** — Documentation only
- [ ] 🌐 **Multiple** — Cross-cutting change

🔒 Security Checklist
<!-- ALL contributors must complete this. Security is non-negotiable. -->
 🔍 Code Review — I have reviewed my own code for security issues
 💉 Input Validation — All user inputs are validated and sanitized
 🚫 No Hardcoded Secrets — Zero credentials, tokens, or keys in code
 📁 Path Safety — All file paths validated, no traversal possible
 🔑 Least Privilege — No unnecessary sudo/root operations
 🧹 No eval — No dynamic code execution of user-provided strings
 🌐 Network Disclosure — All network calls are documented
 📋 Dependencies — All new dependencies vetted for known CVEs
 🔐 Secrets API — Credentials use ash::secrets::* (never plaintext)
 📝 Logging Safety — No sensitive data written to logs
 ⏱️ Temp Files — Temp files use mktemp and cleaned up on exit
